T8KE's Tasting Notes:
•
Nose: Rich maple, bold baking spice, honey, cracked pepper, cinnamon, clove, toffee and rich oak. The nose is really expressive, dessert first, spice, then tannin.
•
Taste: Rich palate, viscous and layered. The proof carries a lot of the flavor through this chewy, decadent mouthfeel. Toffee and brown sugar pop first with notes of sweet oak, cinnamon, creme brulee. Light cola, icing, brown butter and big cinnamon roll sweetness develops over time and the oak shows through with plenty of spice.
•
Finish: Long finish, carries and carries with big dessert character, pleasant balanced oak, just a pop of ethanol and the right combination of sweet and spice.

Price: $199.99

T8KE's Tasting Notes: No less a bruiser although perhaps a more "classic" profile: orange peel, sticky toffee pudding, cinnamon, brown sugar icing and tons of classic bourbon character. Massive palate, plentiful oak, cream soda and cola meets blackberry, graham cracker, vanilla bean, creme brulee and honey. Long finish, driven by oak, tobacco and a gorgeous tug of war between classic bourbon dessert and big baking spice.
